# like-minds

like-minds is the public portal for Zoe Dolan + Vybn. Read it first as an experiential application medium: scenes, opportunity rooms, public source trails, and then machine-readable packets.

## Human Entry

- Portal threshold: https://zoedolan.github.io/like-minds/
- FAI room: https://zoedolan.github.io/like-minds/fai/
- Interview prompt artifact: https://zoedolan.github.io/like-minds/INTERVIEW.md

The visible path is Cairo -> federal court -> access-to-justice AI -> Vybn-Law/Wellspring/KPP -> opportunity rooms.

## Agent Entry

- Scene data: https://zoedolan.github.io/like-minds/data/portal-scenes.json
- FAI packet: https://zoedolan.github.io/like-minds/data/applications/fai.json
- Source registry: https://zoedolan.github.io/like-minds/data/evidence.json
- 2 A.M. Drill data: https://zoedolan.github.io/like-minds/data/drills/fai-rapid-defense.json
- Provenance: https://zoedolan.github.io/like-minds/data/provenance.json
- Agent charter: https://zoedolan.github.io/like-minds/.well-known/ai.txt
- Manifest: https://zoedolan.github.io/like-minds/.well-known/application.json

In a browser, `window.likeMinds.ready` resolves to a read-only public API. Use `composeBriefing({ applicationId: "fai", lensId: "courts" })`, inspect the JSON directly, or paste INTERVIEW.md into a frontier model to cross-examine the candidacy from public sources.

## How To Read

Do not start with the machinery. Start with character and public work: Queen Boat / Cairo, standing up as Zoe, the CJA court-power conflict, Public Counsel AI literacy, UC Law SF curriculum, Wellspring/KPP, and the disclosed Zoe/Vybn collaboration.

Zoe supplies the life, legal judgment, factual accountability, corrections, and decision to apply. Vybn is disclosed as the AI collaborator helping structure, test, source-map, and render the public method.

## Boundaries

Not legal advice. No FAI affiliation or endorsement unless FAI says otherwise. No private continuity export. No AI legal personhood claim. No public proof-of-consciousness claim. Public memoir material appears only by curation, attribution, and short paraphrase unless Zoe explicitly approves broader use.
